title: Trump’s Crypto Project Taps Bonk and Raydium in a High-Stakes Bid to “Rebuild” Solana
summary: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial has disclosed Solana partnerships with Bonk and Raydium, adding USD1 trading pairs, incentives, and launchpad access. USD1’s supply has increased since April 2025 as the project has pursued DeFi growth and leadership hires.The postTrump’s Crypto Project Taps Bonk and Raydium in a High-Stakes Bid to “Rebuild” Solanaappeared first onCryptonews.
